decisive_items: Initial serum β-hCG: 691 IU/L (normal 0-5 IU/L), increased to 1860 IU/L on repeat
Immunostaining positive for AE1/AE3, CAM5.2, inhibin, β-hCG (strongly)
response.rationale: High β-hCG levels and positive immunostaining for β-hCG are more characteristic of choriocarcinoma than trophoblastic tumor

rejected.why: Less specific mechanism and lower β-hCG levels
